title: Verb być — plural
grammarPoint: Present tense of być: jesteśmy, jesteście, są
grammarPoint_fa: زمان حال فعل być: jesteśmy، jesteście، są

explanation.text:
The plural forms of **być** (to be) are used when talking about groups. Note that the third person plural **są** is used for both mixed groups and groups of women.

| Person | Polish | English |
|--------|--------|---------|
| 1st pl. (my) | **jesteśmy** | we are |
| 2nd pl. (wy) | **jesteście** | you (all) are |
| 3rd pl. (oni/one) | **są** | they are |

The distinction between *oni* (mixed or male group) and *one* (all-female group) applies only in past tense — in present tense both use **są**.
notes: jesteśmy = we are (1st person plural — includes the speaker)
jesteście = you are, addressing a group
są is used for all third-person plural (they) regardless of gender in present tense
Negation: nie jesteśmy, nie jesteście, nie są

explanation_fa: اشکال جمع فعل być: jesteśmy (ما هستیم)، jesteście (شما هستید)، są (آن‌ها هستند). توجه: برای مردان یا گروه مختلط از oni+są و برای گروه زنانه از one+są استفاده می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct form: My ___ Polakami.
exercises.explanation: First person plural (my = we) uses jesteśmy. 'My jesteśmy Polakami' = We are Poles.

exercises.hint: Third person plural — same form for all genders in present tense

exercises.explanation: You heard: 'Jesteśmy gotowi.' — We are ready. First person plural jesteśmy.
'Jesteście studentami' = You (all) are students. Wy (you plural) is optional.
Anna i Maria (two people = they) take the third person plural form są. 'Są nauczycielkami' = They are teachers.
